is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles mosquitoes including An. hyrcanus s.l., An. barbirostris s.l., An. dirus s.l., and An. maculatus s.l. (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Sequenced VGSC codon 1014 looking for L1014F and L1014S substitutions in An. hyrcanus s.l. and An. barbirostris s.l. (page 8, 'kdr detection').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Reports that 0 of 37 An. hyrcanus s.l. and 0 of 12 An. barbirostris s.l. had L1014F or L1014S mutations, with all showing wild-type TTG codon (page 8-9, Fig. 4).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Ubon Ratchathani province, northeastern Thailand (Southeast Asia), not in Africa (page 1, Abstract and page 3, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary field collection and bioassay/molecular study conducted in Thailand between 2013 and 2015 (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: Seven sites across five districts in Ubon Ratchathani province, Thailand, with GPS coordinates provided (page 3, Study site).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected between September 2013 and September 2015 (page 3, Mosquito collections).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine field collections conducted under the MALVEC project.

supplement.evidence: All relevant data reported in main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide resistance and screened for VGSC codon 1014 mutations in Anopheles species from Ubon Ratchathani province, Thailand. The paper is ineligible because the mosquito populations were collected in Thailand, not in Africa.
